Profound wasting is compatible with marasmus, but marasmus is an underlying nutritional disorder rather than the acute syndrome after feeding.
Edema and hypoalbuminemia can occur in kwashiorkor, but this does not identify the acute post-refeeding hypophosphatemic syndrome.
The record attributes intestinal failure to massive bowel resection and provides no evidence of celiac disease; celiac disease is not refeeding syndrome.

candidate_relations.reason: There are no characteristic pellagra findings, and pellagra does not explain the abrupt phosphate collapse after nutrition.
Thiamine deficiency can accompany refeeding, but it was not demonstrated and the patient received prophylactic intravenous thiamine.
Profound hypophosphatemia after starting nutrition is the central laboratory feature, but the isolated abnormality omits the full refeeding syndrome diagnosis.
The record does not support Refsum disease, which is unrelated to the acute post-nutrition phosphate decline.
No clinical evidence of vitamin C deficiency is given, and scurvy does not account for the acute refeeding-associated deterioration.

Normal limb radiographs and the acute clinical course do not support osteomalacia; it does not represent refeeding syndrome.
Wernicke encephalopathy can occur during refeeding, but the patient remained alert and oriented without the defining neurologic syndrome.
The 40-cm residual small bowel supports short bowel syndrome as the predisposing condition, but it omits the acute refeeding complication.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Underlying cause of intestinal failure and malnutrition

candidate_relations.reason: Hypokalemia can accompany refeeding syndrome and was present, but alone does not capture the post-feeding syndrome or profound phosphate decline.
